async def test_set_status_disallowed_transition_on_workflow_item_is_move_blocked(
    pg_pool: Any,
) -> None:
    async with pg_pool.acquire() as conn:
        async with conn.transaction():
            s = await _setup(conn)
    tenant, team, client_id = s["tenant_a"], s["team"], s["client_id"]
    ctx = _ctx(pg_pool, tenant, client_id)
    try:
        opened = await MindmapOpenTool()(
            ctx, MindmapOpenInput(title="Gate", root_question="What needs to be done?")
        )
        node = await MindmapWriteNodeTool()(
            ctx,
            MindmapWriteNodeInput(
                map_key=opened.map_key, content="Gated item", node_role="position"
            ),
        )
        await MindmapWorkMarkTool()(
            ctx, MindmapWorkMarkInput(map_key=opened.map_key, node_id=node.node_id, kind="story")
        )
        async with pg_pool.acquire() as conn:
            wf_id = await materialise_legacy_workflow(conn, tenant_id=tenant, team_id=team)
            await conn.execute(
                "UPDATE work_items SET workflow_id = $1, current_stage = status "
                "WHERE memory_id = $2",
                wf_id,
                node.node_id,
            )

        with pytest.raises(JsonRpcError) as exc:
            await MindmapWorkSetStatusTool()(
                ctx,
                MindmapWorkSetStatusInput(
                    map_key=opened.map_key, node_id=node.node_id, status="done"
                ),
            )
        assert exc.value.code == -32602
        assert exc.value.data["code"] == "move_blocked"
    finally:
        await _cleanup(pg_pool, tenant, s["tenant_b"], team, client_id)
EOF
